Subject: Recap + next steps — Deployment mode & compliance (HIPAA / SOC 2)

Hi Jake and Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciated the context on Acme's ingestion patterns and regulatory needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Requirement summary: You indicated PHI will be processed (clinical notes + claims data). Primary concerns are HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2 Type II evidence, and quarterly audit logs for 3rd-party reviewers.
- Deployment modes under consideration: 
  * Hosted API (fastest) — Redwood-hosted; SOC 2 Type II + BAA available; good for quick POCs but shared tenancy
  * Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) — logical isolation, SLA-backed throughput, recommended if you need predictable performance and stronger isolation without full VPC deployment
  * Private (VPC/on-prem) — full customer-managed network and no shared tenancy; required if legal mandates physical/tenant separation or if you need the control plane on your network

Action items I propose:
1) Please confirm whether Acme requires physical separation (no shared tenancy) or if a signed BAA + our SOC 2 report will satisfy legal/security.
2) Priya — can you attach the security controls spreadsheet or questionnaire you mentioned on the call? That will help us map controls to our evidence.
3) We'll send our SOC 2 Type II report and a standard BAA template (attached). Rishi will follow with a Dedicated vs Private summary including lead times and rough costs.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (attached)

Best,

Hi Jake / Priya — looping in some specifics on Dedicated vs Private to help your security and procurement teams: 

Dedicated (Reserved Capacity) — summary:
- Isolation: Dedicated GPU pools (logical isolation) with tenant-level encryption-in-transit and at-rest keys.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report covers the hosted control environment; BAA execution allows PHI processing in Redwood-hosted environments.
- Audit logs: We can configure 1+ year retention and provide export in CSV/SPL formats for your auditors.
- Lead time: ~2–4 weeks to provision reserved capacity after PO and onboarding.
- Cost: Estimate depends on commit length; ballpark monthly committed spend for production workloads like yours: $Xk–$Yk/month (we'll provide a tailored quote once we have usage profile).

Private (VPC / On-prem) — summary:
- Isolation: Full network-level isolation; control plane can reside in your VPC or via on-prem appliance for air-gapped needs.
- Evidence: We assist with control mapping for your security team; customer is responsible for infrastructure-level audits in private/on-prem deployments.
- Audit logs: Can be forwarded to your SIEM or stored in your account with retention per your policy.
- Lead time: ~6–10 weeks (depends on network approvals, infra procurement).
- Cost: Upfront integration and longer-term licensing; typically higher than Dedicated due to integration and support footprint.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Marissa to share standard BAA template (we can redline) — attached draft BAA for your review.
2) Priya/Jake to flag any controls in Acme_Security_Controls_2026.xlsx that require additional artifacts; we will map and respond.
3) If Acme prefers Dedicated, we can prepare an estimated SOW and committed capacity quote within 2 business days once we have expected token/day.
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with our infra team to walk through log export, key management (KMS options), and network diagram.

Attaching: BAA_Acme_v1.docx (BAA draft)
